tool_args.rationale: The monotone, concave pilot is compatible with multiple mechanisms, while s_grad remains near 1. The open-branch probe is the lowest-cost available discriminating measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the avalanche-siphon, Haldane, or Cobb–Douglas model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows vary essentially only u_now; their narrow s_grad range cannot identify gradient dependence or distinguish the candidate mechanisms reliably.
The immediate ambiguity concerns the response across input regimes, not trajectory resolution; this probe also costs more.
It is irrelevant to the mechanism-identification question.
